profile_text.body:
Atlassian is a publicly traded Australian software company, founded in 2002 and headquartered in Sydney, that makes collaboration and project management tools for software, IT, and business teams. Its core products include Jira, Confluence, Trello, and Loom, and the company describes its platform as a connected environment for planning, tracking, and delivering work. Atlassian trades on the Nasdaq under the ticker TEAM and reported revenue of approximately $5.215 billion for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025, according to its most recent 10-K filing.

On the AI side, Atlassian offers Confluence AI, a team wiki product with smart links, automation, and governance features for Atlassian Cloud, and Trello AI, which brings workflow automation and AI capabilities to its project management tool. The company also references Rovo AI agents as part of its broader platform. The site notes that its products are designed to support evolving compliance and regulatory requirements.

No litigation cases or MCP server registrations are recorded in the held facts for Atlassian. The company holds a CIK of 0001650372 with the SEC, confirming its status as a reporting public company.
